summary: Independent read-only design rereview rebuilt and matched design-context-002 and the current frozen spec. RF-001 is addressed by matching suggested Finding references to the current target review stage and context, with stale-context and cross-stage negative cases. RF-002 is addressed by defining atomic create-only publication as the commit point, preserving committed records on cleanup or output failure, and identifying committed state through read-only preflight. Bounded input, freshness, zero-write preflight, guarded version-chain publication and legacy boundaries are implementable. No blocking findings. Technical design review does not replace owner specification approval.
